title: Fracture - Minecraft Arena
description: Hello yellow, new recruit! Are you ready to fight?
body:
Hello, recruit! You've been selected to take part in the Fracture Combat Initiative - an exciting opportunity to make your mark on the universe's newest frontier.

**Endless competition. Real stakes.**

Report for duty, give everything you've got, and who knows? You might just come back a legend! The Initiative is waiting. We'll see you out there.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/fLZ11vTK/images/256f2115ccf5eed55407a6b310529ec10b4290b2.jpeg)

> Where reality cracked, new territory opened. The Initiative was formed to claim it. Sending the best of the best through the fault lines to establish a foothold on the other side. What they found there was untamed, unstable and entirely without rules.

That's where you come in.

# YOUR TASK

The Initiative runs several active disciplines. Find yours.

- **Team Deathmatch** - Two teams. One kill limit. First to hit it wins! Simple, brutal, effective.
- **Team SWAT** - Deathmatch with a twist. One-hit weapons. No room for mistakes!
- **Takedown** - Every death costs time. The only way to end a round is a full wipe. Be careful!
- **King of the Hill** - One point on the map. Hold it or lose it! Everything else is noise.
- **Ball Game** - Balls spawn on the field. Pick them up and carry them to the capture zone! Score more than the other team before time runs out.
- **Breach** - (Coming soon - the Initiative does not share operational details in advance.)
- **Domination** - (Coming soon - the Initiative does not share operational details in advance.)

# YOUR CAREER

The Initiative is watching - make it count.

- **XP** - your permanent record, level up and become the best.
- **Medals** - awarded for skilled plays, decisive moments and exceptional performance. Earn them and be proud.
- **Quests & Achievements** - complete specific tasks for the Initiative.

# FIND YOUR TEAM

The Initiative keeps its recruits informed.

Join the Discord for development updates, early access, and direct contact with the team building this thing. We're moving fast. Stay close.

[Join the Discord](https://discord.playfracture.com) - We'll be in touch.
